title: Outcomes-driven add-on pricing experiment + automated security questionnaire mapping
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise buyers repeatedly request both (1) predictable fine-grained observability retention and SLA guarantees and (2) an easier path through the security questionnaire and contract checklist. Our current add-on UX surfaces retention tiers and SLA as separate line items and requires manual questionnaire mapping by sales, which increases time-to-contract and creates friction for mid-market deals.

Hypothesis: Introducing an outcomes-driven pricing option (measurement-driven tiers that map to concrete business outcomes: latency/uptime targets, per-route retention, and incident response windows) plus an automated security-questionnaire mapping will: 1) shorten sales cycles for deals >= $50k ARR, 2) increase attach rate for premium observability by 15% for enterprise signups, and 3) reduce security review time by 40% via pre-generated, contract-ready questionnaire responses.

What we will build in this ticket:
1) A price/feature matrix for "Outcome Packs" (Baseline, Reliability, Audited) that bundle observability retention levels (7/30/90 days), premium SLA hours and response windows, and a compliance pack (KMS integration + audit logs).
2) A mapping engine that takes answers to our standard security questionnaire and produces: recommended pack, pre-filled contract clauses, and a checklist of outstanding controls for legal/security. The engine will surface two outputs: a human-readable summary page for AE review and a downloadable JSON that maps to the contract automation service.
3) Telemetry and dashboards: an experiment cohort view in Console showing conversion funnels (trial -> pack selection -> contract exec) and per-pack latency/cost delta estimates.

Scope notes: engineering will implement the mapping API and telemetry hooks (ENG-22110, ENG-22847). Legal will approve contract clause templates. Sales/SE will run a 6-week pilot with 8 target accounts. This ticket covers product spec, pricing bands, questionnaire-to-pack mapping rules, success metrics, and pilot orchestration. Implementation tasks are split into follow-ups (ENG PRs and Console UX stories).
acceptance_criteria: Pricing matrix published in Confluence with explicit per-unit math and three outcome packs (Baseline, Reliability, Audited)
Questionnaire mapping engine spec with example mappings for at least 12 common security questionnaire items and decision rules documented
Console experiment dashboard prototype with funnel metrics and cost/latency impact estimators available to pilot AEs
Pilot plan with 8 named accounts and success thresholds (attach rate >= 15% on pilot accounts, median security review time reduced by 40%)
Legal-approved contract clause templates stored in Drive and linked in spec
Telemetry events instrumented by engineering (events list and schema reviewed) and data QAed against synthetic pilot traffic
